title.narrative: To strengthen the health system in Nigeria through targeted interventions that support the federal government to effectively coordinate health investment at all levels for HIV, TB and malaria (ATM) services by 2030 - Nigeria (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Nigeria, RSSH, Lagos State Ministry of Health (LSMOH)This program has the following goals: To strengthen the health system in Nigeria through targeted interventions that support federal government to effectively coordinate health investment at all levels for HIV,TB and Malaria (ATM) services by 2030. The objectives of this program are: Improve coordination of health financing functions at Federal and State level and ensure financial protection for most vulnerable population by contributing to the health insurance scheme.. Advance ATM integrated service delivery in the broader RMNCH platform. Quality improvement and service expansion at health facility and community level. Improve the health information management system (including e-reporting). Improve the logistics information management system. Improve lab system - including on addreditationa nd quality assurance

Percentage of the government budget allocated to health
Percentage of private health units that report data into the national HMIS
LMIS Reporting Rate - Percentage of all health facilities that are required to report that submit an LMIS report to central authority
Percentage of laboratories accredited according to ISO15189 standard or achieving at least four stars towards accreditation or two-star incremental improvement
Percentage execution of the government budget allocated to health
Percentage of laboratories successfully participating in external quality assurance (EQA) or proficiency testing (PT) schemes
Completeness of reporting: Percentage of expected monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are actually received

Percentage of population covered by financial risk protection schemes
Percentage of facilities that implement supportive supervision (meeting all key attributes)
